learning_objective: 🎯 Enjoy a classic Russian comedy (a farce) that satirizes the extreme ego, argumentativeness, and materialistic marriage motives of the wealthy landowning class.

key_vocabulary.hindi_meaning: रोग-भ्रमी (Who always thinks he is sick)

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Ivan Lomov, a 35-year-old wealthy but anxious landowner, comes to his neighbor Chubukov's house in a formal dress. He wants to propose to Chubukov’s 25-year-old daughter, Natalya. Neither Lomov nor Natalya are deeply in love; Lomov just wants a regular life and thinks Natalya is an acceptable, hardworking housekeeper. Chubukov is thrilled to get his daughter married to a rich neighbor.

Lomov is nervous and starts talking about his land touching theirs. He accidentally mentions 'my Oxen Meadows'. Natalya immediately stops him, claiming the Meadows belong to her family. Instead of proposing, Lomov gets into a furious, shouting property dispute with her. Chubukov joins in and kicks Lomov out of the house!

When Natalya finds out Lomov came to propose, she cries and forces her father to bring him back. But as soon as Lomov returns, they start arguing again! This time about whose hunting dog is better: Lomov’s dog 'Guess' or Natalya’s dog 'Squeezer'. The argument gets so intense that Lomov faints from 'palpitations'.

Seeing Lomov unconscious, Chubukov panics, thinking the marriage is ruined. When Lomov wakes up, Chubukov immediately grabs their hands, declares them engaged, and shouts for Champagne, before they can argue again. Even as they are getting engaged, they continue arguing about the dogs!

fun_activity.title: 🎭 The Ego Trap
fun_activity.instructions: The whole play is a joke on human ego. Lomov came to get a wife, and Natalya desperately wanted a husband. Both of their goals aligned perfectly! Yet, their ego over a useless piece of land and dogs almost ruined it. Think about a time you argued with your sibling over a TV remote, completely forgetting the movie you actually sat down to watch!

exam_tips: 📌 Why is Lomov so desperate to marry? (Answer: He is already 35, suffers from severe palpitations and sleep problems, and wants to settle down with a normal, regular life rather than waiting for true love).

📌 Describe the character of Chubukov. (Answer: He is a hypocrite. He calls Lomov his 'angel' when he hears of the proposal, but curses him and kicks him out during the property dispute, only to force him back in when Natalya cries).

📌 What is the central theme of 'The Proposal'? (It is a farce that mocks the marriage traditions of the Russian elite, where marriages were economic deals to merge wealth and property, rather than unions of love).
quick_recap: ⭐ Anton Chekhov is the playwright of this one-act play.
⭐ The Oxen Meadows were disputed land located between the Birchwoods and the Burnt Marsh.
⭐ Lomov bought his dog 'Guess' for 125 roubles, while Chubukov bought 'Squeezer' for 85 roubles.
